name: Platinum Vape | 2g Disposable | Crimson Charge
description:
Power up your vibe.

Crimson Charge hits with an electric blend of cherry, citrus, and a hint of spice — a flavor that’s as bold as it sounds. This hybrid distillate delivers a perfectly balanced lift: energizing on the front end, mellow on the fade, keeping you clear, creative, and in the zone.

Fueled by premium Platinum distillate and packed into a rechargeable 2G all-in-one, every hit is smooth, powerful, and clean from the first draw to the last.

Flavor Profile: Cherry • Citrus • Subtle Spice

Effect: Energized • Creative • Balanced

Device: Rechargeable 2G Distillate Disposable • All-In-One • Dual Airflow Tech
